Bill.BriefDescription: Creating new provisions governing how businesses request for and handle social security numbers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to social security number privacy; and adding a newsection to chapter 50.13 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 50.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Prior to requesting an individual's social security number, allprivate and public business enterprises must state that the request isnot mandatory and that no penalty for withholding this information canbe exacted on the individual by the business enterprise. Allorganizations holding social security numbers that have not beenspecifically granted the authority by federal or state law to possessthis information must purge their files of these numbers within onehundred twenty days of the effective date of this act.
